item.description:
Scriberman 1.0.6

What’s new

  • Search sessions by title or transcript, preview matching text, and jump straight to the matching passage.
  • Identify recordings more easily with readable tag names in the session list.

Fixes

  • Deleting a session now removes leftover media and backups, freeing disk space.
  • Session deletion now requires confirmation from the detail view, helping prevent accidental deletion.
